queries.ledger:
WITH movement_totals AS (
SELECT offer_id,SUM(quantity_delta) AS total FROM inventory_stock_movement GROUP BY offer_id
), pending AS (
SELECT i.offer_id,SUM(i.quantity) AS quantity FROM orders_order_item i
INNER JOIN orders_order o ON o.id=i.order_id WHERE o.status='PENDING_PAYMENT' GROUP BY i.offer_id
)
SELECT s.offer_id,s.available_quantity,COALESCE(m.total,0) AS movement_total,
COALESCE(p.quantity,0) AS pending_quantity FROM inventory_stock s
LEFT JOIN movement_totals m ON m.offer_id=s.offer_id
LEFT JOIN pending p ON p.offer_id=s.offer_id ORDER BY s.offer_id
queries.orders:
WITH totals AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(quantity*unit_price) AS amount
FROM orders_order_item GROUP BY order_id)
SELECT o.id,o.status,o.total::text,o.total=t.amount AS total_matches_items,
p.amount::text AS simulated_payment_amount,s.tracking_code
FROM orders_order o JOIN totals t ON t.order_id=o.id
LEFT JOIN orders_simulated_payment p ON p.order_id=o.id
LEFT JOIN orders_shipment s ON s.order_id=o.id ORDER BY o.id
queries.release_actors: SELECT order_id,performed_by_id,quantity_delta FROM inventory_stock_movement WHERE movement_type='RELEASE' ORDER BY order_id,offer_id

note: Executed operational reconciliation, not Olist sales analysis or a benchmark. Historical counts remain separate from simulated orders.
